name: Trendible Voucher
description: A voucher exclusive to the Astral Imagea Park. Can be used to redeem and open an Imagea mystery box at the Astral Trendibles.
story: In the Imagea Park, nothing gets your heart racing quite like clutching a gift voucher and making your way to the mystery box shop. What wonderful encounters await this time?
